card.name: Marketing exclusivity notice in labels
card.fires_on: The word "marketing" (or the company name just before it) in the notice "due to [Company]'s marketing exclusivity rights, this drug product is...". Also fires on "follow" in "Carefully follow the recommended dosage".

modes.label: Exclusivity notice
modes.description: The word marketing, or the company name before it, in the sentence about a company's marketing exclusivity rights.
modes.example: AstraZeneca AB's Farxiga ® (dapagliflozin) Tablets. However, due to AstraZeneca AB's<< marketing>> exclusivity rights, this drug product is

modes.label: Carefully follow
modes.description: The word follow after Carefully in dosage and preparation instructions.
modes.example: diluents [see Dosage and Administration (2.3 , 2.4) ] . Carefully<< follow>> the recommended dosage and dose preparation instructions for

modes.label: Mineral name ending
modes.description: The ending of a mineral name in a list of cobalt sources.
modes.example: Sources: Cobalt is found in the minerals cobalt<<ite>>, erythrite, and smalt
